description: A PHP class for resetting modules in SuiteCRM, including functions to remove custom fields, layouts, relationships, labels, and extensions, with associated UI rendering and save handling.

classes.name: ViewResetmodule
classes.description: A PHP class extending SugarView to handle module reset operations in SuiteCRM, including UI rendering and cleanup functions.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns parameters for the module title, including the module name and title.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the reset module interface with breadcrumbs and actions.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Processes the reset actions based on user input and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: removeCustomFields
methods.description: Deletes custom fields created in studio for the current module.

methods.name: removeCustomLayouts
methods.description: Removes metadata files for all known studio layouts of the module.

methods.name: removeCustomRelationships
methods.description: Deletes all custom relationships involving the current module.

methods.name: removeCustomLabels
methods.description: Removes language label files for the module.

methods.name: removeCustomExtensions
methods.description: Clears extension files for the module and rebuilds extensions.
